verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents a sales tax API that calculates the tax to collect for a given order, with official client libraries, a sandbox endpoint, and an address-validation endpoint. Nothing in the evidence shows rooftop-level (address-level) accuracy rather than ZIP-based rates, or latency suitable for checkout, so only the core calculation is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of rooftop/address-level rate accuracy, documented response-time or real-time checkout performance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can calculate the right sales tax for a transaction through an API in real time — address-level (rooftop) accuracy, not ZIP-code approximations — fast enough to sit inside checkout
